quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: NAVER Cloud Consortium to Develop AI Models Tailored to (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The NAVER Cloud consortium (33 organizations) was selected to carry out the Korean government's specialized AI foundation model development project in cybersecurity. It began pretraining before the official launch by deploying 4,000 GPUs from existing resources: NAVER Cloud is contributing 4,000 B200 GPUs and LG 256 H200 GPUs, in addition to 256 GPUs provided by the government. It will build two cybersecurity models of approximately 700 billion parameters each with a mixture-of-experts architecture (a HyperCLOVA X-based defensive model and an EXAONE-based offensive model) on approximately 830 TB of training data, with field trials in seven sectors (power, finance, science and technology, telecommunications, semiconductors, defense, aerospace), and plans to release the models as open source for commercial use.
quarterly_data.figure: 4,000 B200 GPUs contributed by NAVER Cloud; two ~700 billion-parameter MoE models; ~830 TB dataset
